inputs.goal: the Q2 2026 call, against the guidance given in Q1

intake.summary: Q2 2026 guidance exceeded Q1 guidance for revenue and EPS, with strong performance in cloud services and operating margin expansion. Revenue grew 15% year-over-year, exceeding Q1 guidance of 12%. EPS of $2.35 exceeded Q1 guidance of $2.10. Cloud services revenue grew 28% year-over-year, representing 65% of total revenue. Operating margin expanded to 28.5%, up from 26.2% in Q1. Free cash flow of $1.2B exceeded Q1 guidance of $1B. Management expressed confidence in continued growth momentum and stated that Q3 guidance remains consistent with previous expectations.
